cat > test.sh <<'EOF'
#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash

> working.txt

while IFS= read -r proxy; do
    [[ -z "$proxy" || "$proxy" == \#* ]] && continue

    echo "Testing $proxy ..."

    for type in socks4a socks5-hostname; do
        result=$(curl -L -sS -o /dev/null \
          --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 \
          --"$type" "$proxy" \
          -w "%{http_code}" https://api.ipify.org 2>/dev/null)

        if [[ "$result" == "200" ]]; then
            echo "[WORKING] $proxy ($type)"
            echo "$proxy $type" >> working.txt
            break
        fi
    done

done < proxies.txt

echo
echo "TEST COMPLETE!"
echo "Working proxies saved in working.txt"
EOF

chmod +x test.sh
